channel.title: Chovy's Blog
channel.description: Tech, agentic coding, and whatever else I'm building. By Anthony "chovy" Ettinger.

item.title: The job board is a blackhole
item.dc:creator: Anthony Ettinger
item.description: Job boards are a way of not reading applications at scale. The referral is the channel that works, and finding who can make it is a search problem an agent is good at.

item.title: Waiting for an application to close, without asking it to
item.dc:creator: Anthony Ettinger
item.description: DiskPush 0.4.0 opens a whole selection, together or one at a time. Detecting when an app is finished with a file turns out to be about pipes, not processes.

item.title: Hoisting is not the job
item.dc:creator: Anthony Ettinger
item.description: An AI screener marked me down for not defining hoisting the way the textbook does. That question stopped measuring anything years ago.

item.title: What AI has actually been caught doing
item.dc:creator: Anthony Ettinger
item.description: NicheDB now carries 314 records of AI incidents from three feeds, each pointing at its evidence, with each source's terms respected per row.

item.title: Letting the agent say it does not know
item.dc:creator: Anthony Ettinger
item.description: The nichedb agent question loop, why declining to answer has to pay zero, and two bugs that only showed up when I ran it

item.title: Open with, and the two lines that lie to you
item.dc:creator: Anthony Ettinger
item.description: DiskPush 0.3.0 adds Open with. Most of the work was two lies in the .desktop format, and a scroll box bug I had already fixed once that morning.

item.title: Every car sold in the US, and what is wrong with it
item.dc:creator: Anthony Ettinger
item.description: NicheDB gets two new collections: every make, model and year sold in the US with NHTSA recalls, owner complaints and crash tests behind a VIN lookup, and a record of what autonomous AI agents have been caught doing.

item.title: readm3 can edit now, and it speaks Reddit
item.dc:creator: Anthony Ettinger
item.description: readm3 0.3.0 adds an edit mode and swaps its hand-rolled parser for marked, with CommonMark, GitHub and Reddit flavors behind a --flavor switch.

item.title: Two movies, forty thousand files
item.dc:creator: Anthony Ettinger
item.description: DiskPush 0.2.17: a pane selection that reached the UI and nothing else, a direction button that did the opposite, and the rsync flag that copies empty folders and exits zero.

item.title: What running 36 agents in a day actually looks like
item.dc:creator: Anthony Ettinger
item.description: 36 agent sessions, 24 working directories, $2390 of API-equivalent spend in 24 hours. What moshcode's herd and cost commands show you, and the two ways the cost table lies if you read it wrong.
